factions.Empire.name: Empire
factions.Empire.description: Masters of wave and trade, the Empire spreads its banner in the name of Order. By decree there are no gods in these waters. Yet in their towers, the nobility dabbles in what they deny.

factions.Fae.name: Fae
factions.Fae.description: A fellowship of forest folk bound not by law but by the old magic that runs in their blood.

factions.Immortals.name: Immortals
factions.Immortals.description: From blighted reaches where old magic pooled and soured, the Immortals emerge. They speak little. Remember much. What they serve, the living cannot fathom.

factions.Merchants.name: Merchants
factions.Merchants.description: Traders who work the sea lanes and the roads between ports, carrying whatever sells. They remember who pays fair and who takes at swordpoint.

factions.Pirates.name: Pirates
factions.Pirates.description: Most pirate crews began on a whaleport deck. Captains elected by vote and plunder split even. The fairest society on the water, funded entirely by other people's work.

factions.Ravagers.name: Ravagers
factions.Ravagers.description: From sun-scorched badlands and fetid swamps the ravagers descend upon lesser folk. Seizing plunder and binding the broken in chains, some for market, others for the pot.

factions.Selkie.name: Selkie
factions.Selkie.description: Guardians of the seas. Though generally peaceful, the Selkies respond with swift vengeance to those who desecrate their waters or harm the whales they consider sacred.

factions.Whalers.name: Whalers
factions.Whalers.description: A chartered union of free tradesmen. Shares are set by charter, widows are paid, and a captain who shorts his crew never sails again. The tryworks must be fed.
